severity: S2: reload readiness and diagnostics can refuse a valid rendered tab

preconditions: Baseline e571e287c runtime/test drivers with new actual-DOM cases; shared tooltip moves title into data-matrx-title.
reproduction: Use actual DOM fixture with button role=tab, tooltip-held Settings label, visible controlled pane and existing production driver observer.
Run normal guarded test:focused-acceptance with the new DOM guards and unchanged baseline drivers.
